'''Barus Rava''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.0}}</ref> Rava led a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to assist the Republic efforts during the [[Invasion of Manaan]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
Rava was born into a military family and was granted a proper education and training to prepare him for his long career. In his [[Platoon/Legends|platoon's]] first deployment, he and his unit were captured by the forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] due to an error of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] intel.<ref name="CX">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Admiral Barus Rava}}</ref>

===Invasion of Manaan===
Around [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Third Galactic War]], Rava responded to a distress call from [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Arn Peralun]]. Rava's Fleet emerged from hyperspace in the [[Pyrshak system]] to find a debris field, the remnants of Peralun's forces. Commanding from a [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]], Rava ordered the [[Alliance Commander]] to enter the debris field and locate the source of the weak signal his ship was picking up. The Commander soon called in to report [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] contact, and Rava ordered his fleet to take evasive maneuvers. After dealing with the fighters, Rava ordered the Commander to resume the search for survivors.<ref name="Dead" />

Awaiting an update from the Commander, Rava was caught off guard when an [[Ion cannon/Legends|Ion Cannon]] shot from [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan's]] surface hit and disabled one of his corvettes. Reacting quickly, Rava contacted the Commander who had located Peralun and the remnants of his crew. Determined to deal with the ion cannon quickly, Rava ordered the Commander and Peralun to bring the survivors back to his fleet and take a stealth shuttle down to Manaan to deal with the cannon. Rava ordered his fleet to fall back until the ion cannon could be neutralized. As the Commander and Peralun began their descent toward Manaan, Rava contacted them to emphasize the importance of preventing Manaan's abundant [[Kolto/Legends|Kolto]] supplies from falling into Imperial hands.<ref name="Dead" />

==Personality and traits==
During the 14 [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of his imprisonment, he was left scarred and his optimistic view for negotiating with the Republic's opponents was shattered. Since his release, he sought to eradicate the Empire's presence from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], which drove him into conflict with other Republic leaders. His controversial ways made him unpopular within the Republic ranks, but he was greatly sought after when decisive action was required.<ref name="CX" />
